answers.answer: Within the extracts provided, no. answer.what_would_change_my_mind: The Objects of the Issue chapter showing proceeds materially deleveraging the balance sheet, and a business chapter that ties the revenue surge to identifiable capacity or customers with normalising receivables, would move both scores up sharply. Conversely, an offer dominated by OFS or evidence the growth came from related-party sales would push me firmly negative.
